$comment: Ground DECIDED (warm cream with crop-motif background, per the client's OpenArt renders). Remaining NEEDS_DECISION items are still open. No competitor names, logos or copy are referenced anywhere in this system.

ground.$comment: Client picked the cream ground from their OpenArt renders, with the crop/paddy line-art running as a background motif rather than a footer ornament.

background_motif.style: crop / paddy line art, single-weight gold, low opacity, bled across the light panels as a ground texture
background_motif.note: Behind type, never competing with it. This is the 'crops like background' the client asked for.

forest.role: dark nutrition block, reversed type, panel fields

gold.role: ALL linework, rules, ornament, botanical illustration
gold.print: NEEDS_DECISION — Pantone 871 C metallic with CMYK fallback, so foil stays an option. Confirm with the printer whether foil is in budget.

cream.role: reversed blocks / paper. Never pure white.

veg_green.warning: Prescribed by regulation, not a brand colour. Do not adjust to match the palette. NEEDS_DECISION — get the exact specified value.

black.role: barcode only. 100% K, never rich black.

product_accents.$comment: One per oil so the range reads as a family on shelf. Used only as a thin band or the botanical tint — never as a ground.

type.$comment: Four families maximum, per the brief. Three named here; the script is the open one.

display_serif.use: Product name. The largest type on the label.
display_serif.note: NEEDS_DECISION — Roboto Slab is honest and legible but it is a slab, not the 'high-contrast serif' your brief asks for. A true high-contrast display serif would look richer against the gold. Alternatives worth licensing: Fraunces (OFL, has an optical-size axis), Playfair Display (OFL), or a paid face from Indian Type Foundry. Say the word and I will set the specimen in whichever you prefer.

text_sans.use: Nutrition table, compliance block, all legal copy. Already the storefront's sans, so pack and site match.

fallback.use: Glyph fallback only. Neither brand face carries the rupee sign U+20B9, and MRP in rupees is a mandatory declaration.

script.use: ONE line only — the tagline. FarmSe uses a script for 'Traditionally Wood-Pressed. Truly Farm Fresh'. Suggest a restrained calligraphic face, not a casual brush.

indic.question: Is the pack English-only (D2C) or English + Telugu/Hindi (retail)? This changes the back-panel architecture completely and is far cheaper to decide now than after 64 SKUs exist. You are Hyderabad-based; if these go into Telangana/AP general trade, Telugu on pack is a commercial advantage.

hierarchy.$comment: Brief's rule. Enforced by the build script, not by eye.

ornament.quote_device: large gold opening/closing quote marks around the story block, per the FarmSe reference
ornament.botanical_style: single-weight gold line drawing, engraving feel. No gradients, no photorealism, no fills.
ornament.wave_motif: paddy/grain line-art along the base of light panels, per the OpenArt renders

panel_content.$comment: From the brief's PANEL CONTENT MAP, cross-checked against the FarmSe photo which is the closest physical reference we have.
side_B_variable: sized as a clean rectangle for the packer's overprint

blocked_on_client: 1L glass bottle dimensions — circumference, label height, shoulder clearance. NOTHING can be built to size without this.
FSSAI licence number, and whether it is the manufacturer's or the marketer's
Nutrition values per product from lab COA
Vector logo master (.ai) — the leaf-N mark is currently redrawn per file
GS1 prefix for real barcodes (placeholder EAN in the meantime, as you asked)
Swachh Bharat / ZED / ISO logos — you said these are coming
Whether foil stamping is in budget, which decides how gold is specified

references.$comment: Physical panel logic only — structure, not styling, and no competitor marks, names or copy are reproduced.
allowed: The client's own OpenArt renders (flat wrap strip layout, cream ground, dark nutrition block)
FarmSe bottle photo supplied by the client (story-panel device: botanical, quote marks, script headline, story, compliance)
excluded: Do NOT reference, reproduce or draw from Anveshan — no logo, no assets, no copy, no naming. Client instruction.
